sbh2.6:2.5: tatra śvāsaḥ yaḥ praśvāsasamanantaraṁ antarmukho vāyuḥ pravartate yāvannābhīpradeśāt |
sbh2.6:2.6: tatrāntarāśvāso ya uparate 'sminnāśvāse na tāvatpraśvāsa utpadyate yadantarālaviśrāmasthānasahagata itvarakālīnastadanusadṛśo vāyurutpadyate |
sbh2.6:2.10: bahirmukho vāyuḥ pravartate bahiḥ nābhīdeśamupādāya yāvanmukhāgrānnāsikāgrāttato vā punarbahiḥ |
sbh2.6:3.9: te ca yathāyogaṁ sa cetkāyasanniśritā eva pravarteran |
sbh2.6:3.10: asañjñisamāpannānāṁ, nirodhasamāpannānāṁ asañjñisattveṣu deveṣūpapannānāṁ sattvānāṁ pravarteran |
sbh2.6:3.14: te ca na yathāyogaṁ tena caturthadhyānasamāpannopapannānāṁ, kalalagatānāṁ ca arbudagatānāṁ, peśīgatānāṁ sattvānāṁ pravarteran |
sbh2.6:4.7: audārikaṁ ca sauṣiryaṁ, sūkṣmaṁ ca sauṣiryam |
sbh2.6:6.4: tatrāśithilaprayogatayā kausīdyaprāptasya styānamiddhaṁ vā cittaṁ paryavanahyati, bahirdhā vā vikṣipyate |
sbh2.6:6.11: te punaḥ sphurakā vāyavo vivardhamānā rujakā bhavanti |
sbh2.6:7.2: tadyathā gaṇanāparicayaḥ, skandhāvatāraparicayaḥ, pratītyasamutpādāvatāraparicayaḥ, satyāvatāraparicayaḥ, ṣoḍaśākāraparicayaśca |
sbh2.6:9.4: yadā āśvāse niruddhe praśvāsa utpadya nirgato bhavati |
sbh2.6:9.6: eṣā hi gaṇanā saṅkhyā nātisaṁkṣiptā nātivistarā iyamucyate ekaikagaṇanā |
sbh2.6:9.13: āśvāsaṁ ca praśvāsaṁ cedaṁ dvayamekatyamabhisaṁkṣipya ekamiti gaṇayati tenocyate dvayaikagaṇanā |
sbh2.6:9.15: anayaivaikaikagaṇanayā, dvayaikagaṇanayā vā, anulomaṁ yāvaddaśa gaṇayati |
sbh2.6:9.18: pratilomaṁ daśa upādāya, navāṣṭau, sapta, ṣaṭ, pañca, yāvadekaṁ gaṇayati |
sbh2.6:9.20: yadā sa ekaikagaṇanāṁ niśritya, dvayaikagaṇanāṁ vā, anulomagaṇanāyāṁ, pratilomagaṇanāyāṁ ca kṛtaparicayo bhavati |
sbh2.6:9.25: ekaikagaṇanayā vā, dvayaikagaṇanayā vā, dvayamekaṁ kṛtvā gaṇayati |
sbh2.6:9.26: tatra dvayaikagaṇanayā catvāra āśvāsapraśvāsā ekaṁ bhavati |
sbh2.6:9.34: tasya ca gaṇanāprayuktasya sa ced antarāc cittaṁ vikṣipyate tadā punaḥ pratinivartyādito gaṇayitumārabhate |
sbh2.6:9.36: yadā cāsya gadhayāccittaṁ svarasenaiva svarasavāhimārgeṇaiva samārūḍhamāśvāsapraśvāsālambanopanibaddhamavyavacchinnaṁ nirantaraṁ, pravartamāne āśvāse pravṛttigrāhakaṁ, niruddhe āśvāse praśvāsaśūnyāvasthāgrāhakaṁ, pravṛtte praśvāse pravṛttigrāhakaṁ, nivṛtte punarnivṛttigrāhakam, avikampyamavicalamavikṣepākāraṁ, sābhirāmaṁ ca pravartate |
sbh2.6:9.45: anyathā gaṇanāmantareṇa teṣāṁ styānamiddhaṁ vā cittaṁ paryavahet, bahirdhā vā cittaṁ vikṣipyeta, gaṇanāprayuktena tu teṣāmetanna bhavati |
sbh2.6:9.46: ye tu tīkṣṇendriyāḥ paṭubuddhayaḥ teṣāṁ punargaṇanāprayogeṇa priyārohatā bhavati |
sbh2.6:9.47: tatropadiṣṭā evaṁ gaṇanāprayogaṁ laghu laghveva pratividhyanti |
sbh2.6:9.49: te punarāśvāsapraśvāsālambanāṁ smṛtimupanibadhya yatra ca pravartante, yāvacca pravartante, yathā ca pravartante, yadā ca pravartante |
sbh2.6:9.52: tasya ca prayogasyāsevanānvayād bhāvanānvayād bahulīkārānvayāt kāyapraśrabdhirutpadyate, cittapraśrabdhiśca |
sbh2.6:10.2: ye cāśvāsapraśvāsā yaścaiṣāmāśrayakāyastaṁ manasi kurvan rūpaskandhamavatarati |
sbh2.6:10.3: yā teṣāmāśvāsapraśvāsānāṁ tadgrāhikayā smṛtyā saṁprayuktā anubhāvanā sa vedanāskandha ityavatarati |
sbh2.6:10.5: yā cāsau smṛtiryā ca cetanā, yā ca tatra prajñā |
sbh2.6:11.2: parijñātaṁ saṁskāramātraṁ, vastumātraṁ, tadā sa eṣāmeva saṁskārāṇāṁ pratītyasamutpādamavatarati |
sbh2.6:11.4: sa evaṁ rūpamanveṣate, paryeṣate, itīye āśvāsapraśvāsāḥ kimāśritāḥ, kiṁpratyayāstasyaivaṁ bhavati |
sbh2.6:11.6: kāyaḥ punaścittaṁ ca kiṁ pratyayaṁ ca |
sbh2.6:11.7: sa kāyaṁ yaḥ cittaṁ ca jīvitendriyapratyayamityavatarati |
sbh2.6:11.10: iti hi avidyāpratyayaḥ pūrvakaḥ saṁskāraḥ sarvasaṁskārapratyayaṁ jīvitendriyaṁ, jīvitendriyapratyayaḥ kāyo, vijñānaṁ ca, kāyacittapratyayā āśvāsapraśvāsāḥ |
sbh2.6:12.1: sa evaṁ pratītyasamutpāde kṛtaparicayo ya ete saṁskārāḥ pratītyasamutpannāḥ |
sbh2.6:12.7: ye jātijarāvyādhimaraṇadharmāṇaste duḥkhā, ye duḥkhāste anātmānaḥ, asvatantrāḥ, svāmivirahitāḥ |
sbh2.6:12.11: yat punarasyā duḥkhajanikāyāstṛṣṇāyā aśeṣaprahāṇametacchāntametat praṇītametat tamevaṁ ca me jānata, evaṁ bahulavihāriṇastṛṣṇāyā aśeṣaprahāṇaṁ bhaviṣyatīti |
sbh2.6:12.12: evaṁ hi samudayasatyaṁ, nirodhasatyaṁ, mārgasatyamavatīrṇo bhavati |
sbh2.6:13.2: darśanaprahātavyeṣu dharmeṣu prahīṇeṣu bhāvanāprahātavyā avaśiṣṭā bhavanti |
sbh2.6:14.2: smṛta āśvāsaḥ ta āśvasan smṛta āśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:14.8: praśrabhya kāyasaṁskārān āśvasan praśrabhya kāyasaṁskārān āśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:14.9: praśrabhya kāyasaṁskārān praśvasan, praśrabhya kāyasaṁskārān praśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:14.11: cittasaṁskārapratisamvedī praśrabhya cittasaṁskārān āśvasan, praśrabhya cittasaṁskārān āśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:14.12: praśrabhya cittasaṁskārān praśvasan, praśrabhya cittasaṁskārān praśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:14.14: abhipramodayaṁścittaṁ, samādadhaccittaṁ, vimocayañcittaṁ āśvasan vimocayan cittaṁ āśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:14.16: anityānudarśī, prahāṇānudarśī, virāgānudarśī āśvasan nirodhānudarśī āśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:15.9: yadā āśvāsaṁ vā praśvāsaṁ vā ālambate tadā dīrghamāśvasimi praśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:15.21: tasmin samaye praśrabhya kāyasaṁskārān āśvasan, praśrabhya kāyasaṁskārān āśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:15.22: praśrabhya kāyasaṁskārān praśvasan, praśrabhya kāyasaṁskārān praśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:15.23: api tu khalu tasyāsevanānvayād bhāvanānvayād bahulīkārānvayāt |
sbh2.6:15.24: ye kharā, duḥsaṁsparśā, āśvāsapraśvāsāḥ pūrva-akṛtaparicayasya pravṛttā bhavanti |
sbh2.6:15.25: kṛtaparicayasya anye ca mṛdavaḥ sukhasaṁsparśāḥ pravartante |
sbh2.6:16.1: sa caivamānāpānasmṛtiprayogeṇa ca yuktaḥ sa cel lābhī bhavati |
sbh2.6:16.2: prathamasya vā dhyānasya, dvitīyasya vā yasmin samaye prītipratisaṁvedī āśvasan, prītipratisaṁvedī āśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:17.3: asmīti vā ayamahamasmīti vā bhaviṣyāmīti vā, na bhaviṣyāmīti vā, rūpī bhaviṣyāmyarūpī bhaviṣyāmi |
sbh2.6:17.5: naiva saṁjñī, nāsaṁjñī bhaviṣyāmītyevaṁ saṁmohasaṁjñācetanāsahagatamiñjitaṁ manthitaprapañcitamabhisaṁskṛtaṁ tṛṣṇāgatamutpadyate |
sbh2.6:17.6: yat tadutpannaṁ laghu laghveva prajñayā pratividhyati |
sbh2.6:17.11: evaṁ cittasaṁskārapratisaṁvedī praśrabhya cittasaṁskārān āśvasimīti āśvasan praśrabhya cittasaṁskārān āśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:18.1: sa cet punarlābhī bhavati maulānāṁ prathamadvitīyatṛtīyadhyānānāṁ sa cāvaśyamanāgamyasya prathamadhyānasāmantakasya lābhī bhavati |
sbh2.6:18.2: sa taṁ niśrityotpannaṁ svaṁ cittaṁ pratyavekṣate |
sbh2.6:18.3: sarāgaṁ vā, vigatarāgaṁ vā, sadveṣaṁ vā, vigatadveṣaṁ vā, samohaṁ vā, vigatamohaṁ, saṁkṣiptaṁ, līnaṁ, pragṛhītamuddhatamanuddhataṁ, vyupaśāntamavyupaśāntaṁ, samāhitamasamāhitaṁ, subhāvitamasubhāvitaṁ, vimuktaṁ cittamavimuktaṁ cittamiti yathābhūtaṁ prajānāti |
sbh2.6:18.6: sa yadā styānamiddhanivaraṇe cittaṁ niśritaṁ bhavati |
sbh2.6:18.16: yadā ca taccittamāsevanānvayād bhāvanānvayād bahulīkārānvayānnivaraṇasamudācārāya dūrīkṛtaṁ bhavati |
sbh2.6:19.1: tasya nivaraṇebhyo vimuktacetaso mārgabhāvanāyā āntarāyikebhyaḥ anuśayā avaśiṣṭā bhavanti |
sbh2.6:19.3: sa teṣāṁ prahāṇāya mārgaṁ saṁmukhīkaroti yaduta saṁskārānityatāmeva sādhu ca, suṣṭhu ca, yoniśaḥ pratyavekṣate |
sbh2.6:19.5: tena ca pūrvaṁ prathamadvitīyatṛtīyadhyānasanniśrayeṇānāgamyasaṁniśrayeṇa vā punaḥ śamathayogaḥ |
sbh2.6:19.6: ṛjuṁ etarhi anityānudarśīvipaśyanāyāṁ yogaṁ karotyevaṁ asya taccittaṁ śamathavipaśyanāparibhāvitaṁ dhātuṣu vimucyate |
sbh2.6:19.13: sa evaṁ trīn dhātūn śāntato manasi kurvan, kṣemataḥ, ārogyataḥ, śamathavipaśyanāṁ bhāvayati |
sbh2.6:19.14: yenāsyāsevanānvayād bhāvanānvayād bahulīkārānvayādavaśiṣṭebhyo bhāvanāprahātavyebhyaḥ kleśebhyaścittaṁ vimucyate |
sbh2.6:19.15: tenāha prahāṇānudarśī, virāgānudarśī, nirodhānudarśī āśvasan nirodhānudarśī āśvasimīti śikṣate |
sbh2.6:21.1: yatra vitarkacaritaḥ pudgalaḥ prayujyamānaḥ priyārohatayā prayujyate |
sbh2.6:21.3: savyokṣepamadhyātmaṁ pratyātmaṁ āsannāsannaṁ yenāsya tatra prayujyamānasya yo vitarkasaṁkṣobhaḥ sa na bhavati |
